sentences.text:
This is the second application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.138/2022 registered at Police Station Manawar, District Dhar (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 376, 376(2)(F), 376(2)(K), 376(2)(I),
376(20(M), 376(AB), 376(3), 342, and 201 of the IPC and Section 3/4, 5(I), 5(M), 5(N)/6 of the POCSO Act.

The applicant is in custody since 17/02/2022.
2.
Learned counsel for the applicant prays for withdrawal of the present bail application.
